as_told.title: Bariloche 1995: pilot can't land and is chased by a UFO

plain: UFOs have shown up near Bariloche, Argentina, a place with its own civilian nuclear energy grid, and in a famous 1995 case a commercial pilot could not land his plane because of a power outage while a UFO chased him. Michels tells this himself in four episodes, without naming a source, adding the plane and the outage only in the later tellings and leaving out the year in one. He raises it as one more case of UFOs gathering around nuclear sites.
